items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: But, it's time for me to go so I told him, well, I'm going.

ctx.x: Burke Bailey I told El, El I've got to make it now. I can't, you know. We had a tremendous band out there, I thought. But, it's time for me to go so I told him, well, I'm going. He was always very thoughtful. A very thoughtful musician. So I came to Camden, New Jersey.
This is the first time you've been that far east?
